priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Export invocation and usage capture

tests.name: run_without_activity_context_exports_parses_and_cleans_temporary_trajectory
tests.description: Every out-of-context invocation exports ATIF, returns normalized usage, and leaves no durable trajectory
tests.arrange: Use a runner that records the command and writes valid ATIF to the requested export path
tests.act: Run DevinHarness without an Activity logging context
tests.assert: The command contains an absolute temporary --export path before existing options, usage is populated, process fields are preserved, and the temporary path is removed after return

tests.name: run_with_activity_context_retains_trajectory_beside_activity_logs
tests.description: Activity invocations retain the raw trajectory in the attempt-scoped artifact directory
tests.arrange: Enter an Activity logging context and use a runner that writes valid ATIF
tests.assert: The export path is the Activity artifact directory's devin-trajectory.json and remains beside activity.log and devin.log

tests.name: run_with_nonzero_exit_still_returns_available_usage
tests.description: Usage capture remains observational when Devin reports failure
tests.arrange: Use a runner that writes valid ATIF and returns a nonzero code with stdout and stderr
tests.assert: The original nonzero code and streams are unchanged and normalized usage is populated

priority_groups.description: Priority 2: Telemetry failure and safe diagnostics

tests.name: run_with_missing_or_malformed_export_preserves_process_result
tests.description: Missing and malformed telemetry never changes a successful or failed Devin result
tests.arrange: Use runners that omit the export or write malformed JSON while returning known process fields
tests.act: Run DevinHarness for each telemetry failure
tests.assert: Each result preserves its original code and streams and has usage set to None

tests.name: run_logs_sanitized_export_and_usage_outcomes_without_trajectory_content
tests.description: Operational diagnostics expose storage and availability only, never raw trajectory data
tests.arrange: Capture Devin logger records while a runner writes ATIF containing a sensitive marker
tests.act: Run DevinHarness through successful and rejected telemetry outcomes
tests.assert: Logs include export path, storage mode, usage availability, and a sanitized rejection category but exclude the sensitive marker and raw ATIF
